title: TRACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: TRACE-MAS：多智能体系统协作故障的诊断与修复
abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform agent-level anomaly detection, which becomes insufficient when failures originate from agent interactions and detected anomalies do not necessarily reveal their true sources. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{TRACE-MAS}, a finer-grained framework for diagnosing and repairing MAS failures. TRACE-MAS learns normal collaborative execution patterns from benign trajectories and detects deviations in agent state changes, message transitions, and task dependency evolutions. It further identifies responsible execution elements through source-aware attribution and selects minimal interventions to restore collaboration while preserving task-critical capabilities. Experiments on five MAS benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE-MAS significantly improves root-cause localization accuracy by \textbf{60.2}\% and achieves consistent gains in task recovery over strong MAS safeguards.
abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）不仅依赖单个智能体的行为，也依赖消息交换、任务依赖等智能体间交互。现有防护方法主要在智能体层面检测异常，难以诊断源于交互的故障，且检测到的异常未必就是故障根因。为此，论文提出细粒度诊断与修复框架 TRACE-MAS。该框架从正常执行轨迹中学习协作模式，检测智能体状态变化、消息流转和任务依赖演变中的偏离；随后通过源感知归因（source-aware attribution）定位引发故障的执行环节，并选择最小干预措施，在保留任务关键能力的同时恢复协作。在五个 MAS 基准上，相较于有竞争力的防护方法，TRACE-MAS 的根因定位准确率提升了 60.2%，任务恢复表现也持续改善。
key_points_zh: 仅检测单个智能体的异常，难以发现由消息交换或任务依赖引发的协作故障；异常出现的位置也不一定是根因所在。
TRACE-MAS 从正常执行轨迹中学习协作模式，同时监测智能体状态、消息流转和任务依赖三个层面的偏离。
通过源感知归因定位引发故障的执行环节，再以最小干预恢复协作，同时保留任务关键能力。
在五个 MAS 基准上，根因定位准确率较有竞争力的防护方法提升了 60.2%，任务恢复表现也 consistently 优于这些方法。

llm_assessment.comment: Attributing collaboration failures to specific state, message, and dependency transitions makes traces actionable for targeted runtime recovery.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 将协作故障归因到具体的状态变化、消息传递和依赖关系变化，使执行轨迹能够指导有针对性的运行时恢复。
